summary: A 16-ft-square 1931 cabin on Yellowstone's Mount Sheridan, staffed through the 1930s and remote; its build year and county are disputed and current access is unknown.

facts.design: One-story 16 x 16 ft cabin on a concrete foundation; uncoursed rubble-masonry base, frame upper section, hip roof

access.note: Inside Yellowstone National Park. No source read says whether the cabin is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: Backcountry hike: about eight miles to the base, then almost 3,000 ft of climbing over three more miles, per the Outside Bozeman column's account of a 1975 visit.

events.note: One-story 16 x 16 ft cabin on a concrete foundation, after 1930 Park Service blueprints. One column gives 1926; not supported by other sources.
Floyd Keller named as fire lookout on the summit in a 1934 newspaper item
Lookout Harvey Crowder badly injured after a snow drift gave way during a July 1935 visit
Lookout reported heavy smoke from a fire believed started by lightning near Madison Lake; about fifty CCC enrollees sent by pack horse
Listed as lookout personnel 1963-1987 as Jim McCown; no other source found for this name
Visitor met a lookout called only Jim; surname not given, so no confirmed link to the McCown listing
Same Jim found at Mount Washburn Lookout; said he had transferred because Sheridan was isolated
Registered June 1, 2004 as US 577, WY 11; nominated by James Muhn

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 1931 is used: the register and WillhiteWeb agree on 1931, after 1930 blueprints. The 1926 date in the Outside Bozeman column has no second source; the story reports both.
The register says Park County; lookout listings say Teton County. The story reports both rather than choosing one.

notes_for_editor: Built year and register data are well sourced. The 1926 build date (Outside Bozeman) is unresolved and reported as a conflict. Jim McCown (1963-1987) rests on one listing and is not confirmed; the 1975 visitor's Jim is unnamed, so the story does not link them. Current condition is inferred from a standing listing and a photo caption; no recent condition report was read. A search summary attributed a 1991 removal to this lookout, but the Outside Bozeman article's 1991 removal concerns Divide Lookout, not Sheridan, so it is not used. Blueprint location conflicts: WillhiteWeb says the Montana State Library holds them; Montana History Portal item 93097 credits the Yellowstone National Park Heritage and Research Center. Access level is unknown; no source read says whether the cabin can be entered. Height is not stated in any source; elevation_m is from the register. The record's Park County is supported; the Teton County listing is the only conflict.
